name: Paralo
one_liner: Paralo builds a single operating system for golf clubs, replacing the separate legacy tools a club runs its tee sheet, competitions, live scoring, member app, till, and finances on, plus a connected app for the golfers themselves.
headcount_source: Qualitative estimate, not a published figure: a company incorporated in December 2025 with two directors on the register, raising a GBP270k pre-seed. Uncertain.

name: Medly AI
location_text: 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF
one_liner: Medly builds an AI tutor for exam revision, giving students personalised practice and instant feedback across GCSE, A-Level, IB, AP, and SAT courses.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate, not a published figure: no headcount appears on the site or in the funding coverage. Inferred from a company two years past incorporation raising an $8m seed with four serving directors. Uncertain; confirm before relying on it.

name: Metal Morph
location_text: Ashmere Grove Flat 1, 24 Ashmere Grove, London, SW2 5UJ
one_liner: Metal Morph recovers the aluminium and iron-based treatment chemicals that water and wastewater plants would otherwise discharge, and puts them back into the treatment process on site, so a plant buys less new chemical and sends less waste away.
headcount_source: Scout reporting described a nine-person team in August 2026, consistent with a company incorporated in February 2025 with one director on the register. Press-reported, not independently verified.

name: Mindgard
one_liner: Mindgard is an AI security platform that finds the AI systems an organisation is actually running, including the ones nobody registered, red teams them for weaknesses, and then defends the models, agents, and applications at runtime.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate, not a published figure: no headcount appears on the site or in the funding coverage. Inferred from a six-person named leadership team, dual Boston and London operations, and roughly $42m raised in total. Uncertain; confirm before relying on it.

name: Cytix
one_liner: Cytix is a security decision layer for teams whose software never stops changing: it assesses the risk each change introduces, continuously rather than at an annual pen test, and automates the approvals that follow.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate, not a published figure: no headcount appears on the site or in the funding coverage. Inferred from a company founded in 2022 raising a $7m Series A with four roles open on its public job board. Uncertain; confirm before relying on it.

name: Intropy
one_liner: Intropy builds an AI-native operating system for the spare-parts trade: it plugs into a distributor's existing systems and automates the inventory, pricing, obsolescence, and salvage decisions that distributors, manufacturers, and recyclers still make by hand in spreadsheets.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate, not a published figure: no headcount appears in the funding coverage or on the company site. Inferred from a company incorporated in December 2023 raising a seed round of this size and stating it will expand the team. Uncertain; confirm before relying on it.

name: Agon
location_text: C/O Founders Law Hamilton House, 1 Temple Avenue, London, EC4Y 0HA
one_liner: Agon builds synthetic battlefields, virtual environments where autonomous defence systems such as counter-drone platforms train at machine speed against adaptive adversaries modelled on live conflict intelligence, long before they meet a real threat.
headcount_source: Qualitative estimate, not a published figure: a company incorporated 2025-07-24 that launched out of stealth in July 2026 with a 30m-dollar seed and offices in London and Berlin. Treat as uncertain.

name: LemonEdge
one_liner: LemonEdge builds fund accounting and operations software for private markets, replacing the spreadsheets and legacy systems that private equity firms, fund administrators, and family offices still run their accounting, data, and reporting on with one auditable platform.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate, not a published figure: no headcount appears in the funding coverage or on the company site. Inferred from a company operating across London and New York and raising a Series A of this size. Uncertain; confirm before relying on it.

name: Arrakis
location_text: B1 Vantage Park Old Gloucester Road, Hambrook, Bristol, BS16 1GW
one_liner: Arrakis is an industrial AI company whose platform deploys AI agents into mission-critical operations for enterprises in sectors such as aerospace and defense, energy, engineering and construction, shipping, and telecommunications, without requiring them to replace their existing systems.
headcount_source: Fortune and The Next Web report approximately 15 employees as of July 2026, with the company planning to triple headcount; the UK company was incorporated 19 December 2025, so it is about seven months old. Treat as a reported figure at the low end of this bucket.

name: Tyred
location_text: 5th Floor Palladium House, 1-4 Argyll Street, London, W1F 7TA
one_liner: Tyred is a London company that sends bike mechanics to riders on demand and services shared e-bike fleets, including roughly 50,000 of Lime's bikes in London, while building a connected 'ownership' platform that bundles bike repairs, maintenance, insurance, warranty, and finance.
headcount_source: No public headcount figure; qualitative estimate of the core team for a 2022-founded seed startup that has raised GBP2.5m and is hiring engineers. Its field mechanic operation is larger (100,000+ bikes serviced in the past year and a roughly 50,000-bike Lime fleet in London) and is likely partly a contractor network, so this bucket reflects the core company only and is uncertain (BikeBiz and ZAG Daily, 16 July 2026).

name: Valarian
location_text: Unit 4.04, 175 High Holborn, Tottenham Court Road, London, WC1V 7AA
one_liner: Valarian builds sovereign infrastructure, delivered as a hardened Kubernetes control layer called ACRA, that lets governments, defence, and regulated enterprises run high-consequence AI and other sensitive workloads while keeping control over where their data lives and who can access it.
headcount_source: Press reported about 31 staff in London around the Series A, 2026-07; consistent with the 26-50 bucket and the leadership team named on valarian.com/about. The 31 figure is press-reported and was not independently re-verified in this pass.

name: Meticulous
one_liner: Meticulous makes an AI testing tool that records real usage of a web app and automatically writes and maintains its end-to-end UI tests, catching visual and behavioural regressions so engineering teams do not have to hand-write frontend tests.
headcount_source: Bucketed estimate. The company's Y Combinator profile lists a team of roughly 15, and the live Ashby careers board shows 7 open roles (5 London, 2 San Francisco), 2026-07.

name: Prolo
one_liner: Prolo is an AI-powered procurement platform for small and mid-sized construction firms, helping builders source, compare, and buy materials, equipment, and hire from a nationwide network of more than 185 supplier brands at competitive trade rates.
headcount_source: No headcount figure published in the funding press; the live public team page (https://prolo.io/team) lists 14 named team members, so bucketed as 11-25. Verified 2026-07-27.

name: Kord
location_text: 853-859 Salisbury House 29 Finsbury Circus, London, EC2M 5QQ
one_liner: Kord is an FCA-regulated platform that combines identity verification, AML and compliance checks, client onboarding and e-signing, and payment processing into a single system for regulated industries such as estate agents, law firms, and conveyancers.
headcount_source: Estimate only; no public headcount figure found. Inferred from Series A stage, revenue reported growing from about GBP600k to GBP4m in a year, 100+ paying customers, and two product lines. Treat as an estimate, not a confirmed number.

name: Whering
one_liner: Whering is a digital wardrobe app that lets people catalogue the clothes they already own, plan and style outfits from them, and shop more intentionally.
headcount_source: About page states a team of over 20 people, based in Farringdon, London (whering.co/about, verified 2026-07-12). Bucketed as 11-25.

name: geoSurge
location_text: 167-169 Great Portland Street Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF
one_liner: geoSurge is a London deep-tech company whose platform helps brands measure, understand, and improve how they are represented inside large language models and AI search such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, using its proprietary Corpus Engineering method.
headcount_source: No absolute figure published; soft estimate from a just-closed $12m seed with active hiring and press noting headcount doubled since a 2025 stealth exit. Treat as an estimate; it could be under 10.

name: StirlingX
one_liner: StirlingX runs a sovereign data intelligence platform that captures, secures, and fuses multi-sensor data into defence-grade insight for critical national infrastructure, defence, and government customers.
headcount_source: No public headcount. Estimate from the /about page (seven named operational leaders plus a chairman and advisors) and the Series A plan to grow the engineering team; treat as an estimate.

name: Xylo
one_liner: Xylo builds an AI-agent workspace for UK local-authority planning teams that automates the administrative work on planning applications, chasing documents, verifying submissions, and compiling responses, while final judgement stays with planning officers.
headcount_source: Stage-based estimate: pre-seed, incorporated December 2024, two co-founder directors on Companies House, no team or careers page on the live site. No public headcount figure.
